facts.text: Four nights each week during the academic year, Claremont McKenna's Marian Miner Cook Athenaeum hosts guest speakers, where students share dinner and engage in question-and-answer discussions with visiting speakers.

sources.title: Athenaeum | Claremont McKenna College
sources.quote: Four nights a week during the school year, the Ath brings scholars, public figures, thought leaders, artists, and innovators to engage with the CMC and Claremont College community.
